title: Claimed 'cross-arm guard does not satisfy' hardening did not land: the lint's 35-line guard window is still unscoped to the enclosing arm
evidence:
window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
        if not guarded:
            violations.append(f"  client.gleam:{idx + 1}: {line.strip()} (scope: {arm_name})")
detail: The arm-walk computes scope but the guard check ignores arm boundaries. Reproduced on a copy of the tree: an unguarded payment_api.check_unlock_consent call in a fresh arm 10 lines below client.gleam:4217's unrelated 'case model.demo_mode {' passes the lint (exit 0); the same call 40 lines below fails (exit 1). The r3 bar required this bite-test to fail.
recommended_fix: Cap the guard window at the enclosing arm boundary found by the walk (start the window at lines[j], not idx-35), then re-run the cross-arm bite-test and assert exit 1.

title: Claimed 'manifest drift must fail' hardening did not land: DEMO_INTERCEPTED is never checked against demo_update.handle, and two entries already have no demo arm
evidence:
path = "client/src/client.gleam"
...
        if arm_name in EXEMPT_ARMS or arm_name in DEMO_INTERCEPTED:
            continue
detail: The lint reads only client.gleam; no cross-check of DEMO_INTERCEPTED against demo_update.handle exists. Reproduced: adding a bogus message to DEMO_INTERCEPTED plus an unguarded payment_api call under that arm passes (exit 0). Live drift today: ApiReturnedConsentCheck/ApiReturnedExtensionConsentCheck are listed but have no demo arm; their real arms call payment_api.create_checkout (client.gleam:3707-3724), exempted solely by the hand-maintained 'never produced' comment.
recommended_fix: Mechanically parse demo_update.handle arms and fail the lint when a DEMO_INTERCEPTED message has no demo arm (or an explicit never-produced justification list); drop or intercept the two consent-check entries.

title: Three allowlisted 'demo-branched' helpers contain no demo branch - the lint's stated contract is false for them
evidence:
# Helpers that branch on demo_mode internally (verified to carry the store).
DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS = {
    ...
    "fire_refcheck_slot_action",
    "fire_refcheck_call_action",
    "save_refcheck_edit",
}
detail: fire_refcheck_slot_action (client.gleam:7313), fire_refcheck_call_action (7346) and save_refcheck_edit (7420) contain zero demo_mode references; they fire real reference_checks_api writes. Demo-safe today only because demo_update intercepts UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserConfirmedRefcheckAction/UserSavedRefcheckEdit. Any future demo-reachable call site passes the lint undetected (r2 warning 11 residual).
recommended_fix: Move the three helpers to a caller-interception exemption list with that reasoning, or add real demo_mode branches; keep DEMO_BRANCHED_HELPERS for helpers that genuinely branch.
